issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary issue FHIR-13844 requested that the old Using SNOMED CT with FHIR Version issues section explicitly state that SNOMED CT version URI values may include a UTC time part rather than only a YYYYMMDD release date.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in commit 1c78b00bec05517930a344e47fe16f8da21d4786 / svn r13448, which added YYMMDDThhmmssZ wording to source/snomedct.html. Neighboring March 2018 SNOMED CT URI and SNOMED-on-FHIR review commits retained and refined the clarification.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-17649 applied SNOMED International/SNOMED-on-FHIR requested updates and removed the timestamp sentence from source/snomedct.html. Vocab minutes on 2018-10-11 recorded that SNOMED CT version identification and inclusion of time parts needed further discussion. FHIR-35933 and UP-289 subsequently moved the external-code-system Using X pages from FHIR core to THO, deleting source/snomedct.html from this repository. Current core source links to https://terminology.hl7.org/SNOMEDCT.html and keeps only the SNOMED CT Usage Report in core.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source was changed because the requested page is no longer a current FHIR core build artifact, and adding partial SNOMED CT version guidance to the remaining core summary/link pages would duplicate or override the THO-owned page.
